purpose: Provide deterministic translation-only locks along an arbitrary fixed world-space direction while leaving perpendicular translation unconstrained, with direct integration into the shared one-step constraint composer.

properties.locks: bounded explicit body pairs with finite non-zero world-space direction vectors and projected offsets
properties.options: bounded pre/post position and velocity iteration counts

limitations: direction does not rotate with bodies
not a full prismatic or slider joint
shared composer integration is direct-only in v0.2; the activity-gate and collision-isolation wrappers still cover the earlier five families and are not direction-lock aware
no angular inertia, rotating anchors, angular limits or motors
post-core projection can change positions after donor contact evidence was produced

proves: fixed-direction locks can participate as the appended sixth family around exactly one donor-core integration step while preserving perpendicular freedom and deterministic replay

truth.basis: The capability is named and evidenced as a fixed world-space projected translation constraint, not a rotating local-axis or full prismatic joint, and the remaining wrapper boundary is explicit.

agency.basis: Callers choose body pair, direction, projected offset, activity state and bounded solver parameters.

continuity.basis: The donor core remains untouched and the primitive is reused by the existing composer rather than replaced or silently reimplemented.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Composer integration reuses the primitive without chaining step wrappers, preventing a hidden second donor-core integration; activity/isolation integration remains deferred until those wrappers explicitly support the sixth family.
